scope: opt-in engineering-only full reference HybridPilot SSM/attention/TTT/depth composition; NO network/GPU/scheduler/FORGE/scientific-source-first-use
hypothesis: An opt-in bounded factual prefix plus persisted original TTT fast matrix exactly reproduces the unmodified original full HybridPilot's causal full-sequence outputs across separately confirmed calls, while speculative previews are pure and independently composed for each action.

algorithm.factual_input: caller-supplied analog events [B,L,D] all true confirmation bool [B,L]; caller is responsible for authenticating physical action and observed outcome
algorithm.source: two hand-authored deterministic random tensors seeds 64 and 86; no environmental scientific cohort
algorithm.state: history tensor of only confirmed original analog events, plus existing TTTFactualState fast_weights/count; no optimizer state in factual state
algorithm.pre_ttt: original HybridPilot.stem -> original SelectiveStateBlock -> original CausalAttentionBlock recomputed on confirmed prefix; ONLY new factual transformed embeddings update persisted original StreamingTTT
algorithm.hypothetical_preview: separately append each candidate analog feature to a common factual prefix for pre-TTT context; read persisted TTT matrix with no fast-weight write; apply equivalent pure depth path with no telemetry side effects
algorithm.costs: explicitly record reference CPU timings; no speedup claim because full SSM/attention prefix recomputed per fact/query

controls.chunking: 1+2+3 and 3+3 followed by two separate candidates
negative: over capacity rejects before model update
hypothetical preview leaves all model weights, factual state and depth utilization unchanged
controls.cold_resume: serialize weights-only original model state_dict plus factual tensor history/matrix/count; compare continued factual ingestion and hypothetical output against uninterrupted state at exact bytes
controls.gradient: factual history and pure-preview output have differentiable path through original stem, SSM, attention, TTT and head
